Before serving, the pod measures how alike every two experts' outputs are on Bob's normal (never held-out) job words (llama-expert-pair, pod patch 0016); the PC pairs each off expert of all-keep-80 with its most alike kept one (expert-redirect.mjs). Rules (expert-redirect.mjs): a kept expert's gate weight is its own share plus its paired off experts' shares, before the top-k pick; no two picks can land on one expert. Nothing is cut, healed, saved or uploaded.
